text:
```sql
SELECT id, reparto, stato, importo, responsabile, data
FROM (
    SELECT id, reparto, stato, importo, responsabile, data,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY data DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS rn
    FROM progetti
) sub
WHERE rn = 1;
```<|im_end|>
